title: Personal Loans Returned-Payment Fee Calculation Note
content:
## Calculation

The returned-payment fee of a Personal Loans loan is the fee of the latest returned payment on the loan (on a tie of dates, the first one recorded). The returned-payment fee schedule follows the loan's origination state: schedule B for CA, CO, CT, MA, ME, MN, NY and VT, schedule C for MD, NC and WI, and schedule A for every other state. The returned-payment fee is the schedule's amount, rounded to the cent, the rounding coming once, at the end.

| Fee schedule | Returned-payment fee, every grade |
|---|---|
| A | 15.00 USD |
| B | 10.00 USD |
| C | 0.00 USD |

## Worked figures (hypothetical loans)

| Origination state | Fee schedule | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| Ohio | A | 15.00 |
| Colorado | B | 10.00 |
| Maryland | C | 0.00, so no fee line is written |

## Which return

Where two returned payments on the loan carry the same latest date, the one recorded first is the latest returned payment.
